description: Fish and chips on two banks of a frozen river. Every ingredient is on the west bank; the plates, boards and serving hatch are on the east. Ice floes drift down the river and are the only way across. The snow along the counters grips; the open ice does not.
strategy: Fry in the east bank's fryer so a chopped piece never has to cross the water again. Dash onto a floe and off the other side rather than riding it. There are only two plates, so wash them as soon as they come back.
